crossRefs.note: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.
But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?
But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.
He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.
I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.
translations.bsb: However, there are some of you who do not believe.” (For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray Him.)
translations.kjv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.
translations.asv: But there are some of you that believe not. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who it was that should betray him.
